title: Weather and Inventory
author: Ada Voss
blurb: Zephyrine Vane, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
